draft.subject: Your two questions — weekly summaries and VAT invoices
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for the two notes, and sorry you're still waiting on them. On the first: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, so no manual screenshots workaround exists today. On the second: a VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings, and your ticket is still open with us so we'll follow it through.

Since you've got your first project up in Wrenfield, want me to walk through getting your team's real work and a teammate or two into it? Happy to take 15 minutes this week.

Best,
Nadia
